Chad Dingmann Iv reached out to Pam Baumgarten about this.

I think the problem is there should be a default type in https://eoriginal.atlassian.net/browse/EC-12000?search_id=41bd6133-244b-471d-8b79-e0eccb11dc04 when it does not have that media type, but im not too sure.

Kevin Smith Pam Baumgarten mediatype should be an optional parameter for the API call. I am going to send the ticket back to Dev to work on it.

Rae KaphleOK, im going to not submit a ticket since it was in QA ready and link this to the POD monitoring.

Ill just assign this one to myself and move it to on hold until its fixed in the EC ticket.

Chad Dingmann
Rae Kaphle Yep. A/C 3b (“mediaType is optional since requiring it would break existing integrators”).
Chad Dingmann Looks like this should be fixed as of the POD release this morning.
